summary: Describes steps an implementation can take between receiving user input and handing permitted code points to the IDNA2008 protocol, since IDNA2008 itself assumes input is already from a permitted set. It is informational.

eli5.summary: If you type a name with capital letters or odd characters, something has to tidy it up before it goes out. This describes how to do that tidying.

questions: how to normalize user input for idna
